bio: In the heart of the picturesque town that serves as a gateway to Val Formazza stands a welcoming establishment where familial warmth blends with a touch of contemporaneity. In the kitchen Denis, joined in the dining room by his wife Sabrina, knows how to pamper guests with a series of dishes that evoke tradition while being reinterpreted with imagination and modern sensitivity. Not to be missed is their signature “Walser Beef Filet,” a true house specialty, though the “venison ossobuco with cream of potato and blueberry compote” also merits a taste.
